topic: Mapping urban and rural demographic codes
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on understanding and mapping specific urban and rural demographic codes (e.g., "151-00151 Ballerup"). The goal is to determine if these codes can be mapped to postcodes.

Multiple links were shared pointing to statistical databases for reference, with the preference being given to using the more detailed report structure over mapping by area name.
decisions: The investigation into demographic code mapping will continue on a later date.
action_items: Check the data/mapping feasibility again tomorrow.
